notes.title: Update Announcement on August 2nd
notes.content: Update announcement on August 2nd: Korean and Russian local languages have been updated and optimized, and some contents have been optimized.

notes.title: "DREAD FLATS" Gratitude Letter & Free DLC Roadmap
notes.content:
To all players:
Thank you for your passion and feedback! We’re fully aware of the game’s imperfections, but every suggestion fuels our progress. Over the next month, we’ll focus on:Short-Term Plans (Within 1 Month)
・Priority fixes for high-frequency bugs and QoL issues based on community reports.
・Enhanced localization for additional languages.

Free DLC Preview
Currently in development:
・Expanded Lore: Answers to unresolved plot mysteries.
・New Horrors: More chilling encounters and designs.
・100% Free: A thank-you gift for your support!

We’re endlessly grateful to every player.

notes.title: Regarding the unresponsive main menu issue and 2K resolution update.
notes.content:
[olist]
We sincerely apologize that some players using 2K resolution experienced unresponsive main menu buttons upon launch. This issue has been fixed in yesterday's update.
[/olist]
However, we regret to inform affected players that deleting configuration save files may still be required to resolve this problem completely.

Solution steps:
[olist]
Navigate to:
C:\\Users\\Administrator(your username)\\AppData\\Local\\project_A

Delete all files in this folder

Relaunch the game
[/olist]
